design: Reconstruct every saved first-day eight-window smoke inference from the frozen grid and order state, and verify exact features and saved model scores. Profile100repetitions of the same inference cases using cProfile. Positive feature/score equality and deliberately corrupted score refusal precede timing. No fitting, model selection, policy change or replay mutation.
limits: A small repeated inference microbenchmark, not a whole-engine profile, end-to-end latency estimate, independent statistical sample or strategy-performance test. cProfile adds overhead. Do not infer an optimization speedup without a separately checked comparison.
